title: Estimating chances from data
intro: Much of the field is really estimating how likely something is — a click, a fraud, the next word — by learning those chances from mountains of past behaviour.
why: It works because with enough independent observations the fraction of times something happened is a trustworthy estimate of how often it will happen again — and the more you've seen, the tighter that estimate becomes. It also means a few well-chosen random samples can stand in for a huge population, because their average reliably reflects the whole.

papers.title: PerQA: A Benchmark for Temporally Sensitive Questions on Heterogeneous Personal Data
papers.uses: Answers questions about personal data by aggregating events over time, where many questions require filtering by dates and summing counts or patterns.

papers.title: VarParser: Unleashing the Neglected Power of Variables for LLM-based Log Parsing
papers.uses: Parses logs by sampling and caching based on variable parts (IDs, numbers, paths), not just constant text, reducing the amount of text sent to language models.

papers.title: Revisiting Graph-Level Anomaly Detection: From Partially to Fully Unsupervised Learning
papers.uses: Detects abnormal graphs by modeling uncertainty around predictions, allowing the system to down-weight ambiguous samples that might be anomalies during training.

papers.title: Understanding Strategic Platform Entry and Seller Exploration: A Stackelberg Model
papers.uses: Model when a platform will enter a market to compete with sellers, balancing its own profit against information it learns over time.

papers.title: Modeling Cascaded Delay Feedback for Online Net Conversion Rate Prediction: Benchmark, Insights and Solutions
papers.uses: Predict the net conversion rate (purchase and no refund) by modeling the two delays separately and learning patterns over time from continuous feedback.

papers.title: Resisting Manipulative Bots in Meme Coin Copy Trading: A Multi-Agent Approach with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.uses: Use a reasoning model to estimate the probability that a copy-trade target is manipulated, combining signals across chat sentiment, trading patterns, and bot behavior.

papers.title: EcoTune: Edge-Cloud Collaborative Model Adaptation for Budget-Constrained On-Device SLM Personalization
papers.uses: Select the most informative user interactions for cloud annotation using a multi-armed bandit, then adjust only the most critical model layers on-device.

papers.title: Exploring the Domain Sensitivity of AI Chatbots in Correcting Misinformation
papers.uses: Train a chatbot to correct misinformation by learning correction strategies, then measure how well it reduces false belief across health, science, and politics domains.

papers.title: Online Rounding and Pricing Schemes for k-Rental Problems
papers.uses: Solve the fractional allocation online, then round to integers using controlled randomness to preserve the cost guarantee.

papers.title: Camel: Frame-Level Bandwidth Estimation for Low-Latency Live Streaming under Video Bitrate Undershooting
papers.uses: Estimate true available bandwidth by watching frame-by-frame network feedback, then weight the sending rate and burst pattern to match the frame bursts without overflowing the network.

papers.title: Energy-Efficient and Dequantization-Free Quantization of LLMs: A Spiking Neural Network Approach to Salient Value Mitigation
papers.uses: Reduces how much energy a language model consumes by storing only a few important numbers in full precision while storing the rest as binary counts, avoiding expensive arithmetic during use.

papers.title: Expectation-Maximization Driven Contrastive Disentanglement for Generalized Category Discovery
papers.uses: Discovers new categories by using a probabilistic model to soft-identify which samples belong to novel categories, then pulls similar samples close and pushes apart ambiguous ones.

papers.title: llm-tuna - Hyperparameter Optimization for LLM Inference
papers.uses: Searches for optimal deployment settings (batch size, parallelism) by testing configurations intelligently across multiple hardware setups to maximize throughput.

papers.title: Marketing Hosting: From Fixed to Endogenous Budgets
papers.uses: Optimizes marketing spending when the budget itself depends on how well campaigns perform, learning the reinvestment rate that balances reward with risk of running out of money.

papers.title: MiniAMIE: Quick and Dirty Rule Mining on Knowledge Graphs
papers.uses: Approximates which rules in knowledge graphs are most useful by testing quick estimates instead of exact measurements, speeding up mining.

papers.title: Meteor: High-Performance Control Message Delivery for Large-Scale Clouds
papers.uses: Routes control messages through either fast direct calls or slower queues, automatically switching between them based on which keeps delays lowest for each situation.

papers.title: Industrialized Deception: The Collateral Effects of LLM-Generated Misinformation on Digital Ecosystems
papers.uses: Evaluates whether people can tell apart human news from AI-generated news, testing both detection and generation to understand how well AI fools readers and vice versa.

papers.title: Users Pay Twice: The Hidden Energy Cost of Web Advertising
papers.uses: Measure CPU activity across millions of real web visits to estimate the energy cost that ads and tracking add to each page users browse.

papers.title: Mind the Ambiguity: Aleatoric Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs for Safe Medical Question Answering
papers.uses: Teaching a system to notice when a user's question has multiple meanings and ask for clarification, by detecting ambiguity directly from the system's internal thought-patterns.

papers.title: Coarse-Fine: A Novel VPA Strategy for Boosting Resource Utilization of Transient Offline Tasks
papers.uses: Adjusting computer resource requests for tasks by combining cluster-wide trends with sliding-window patterns specific to each task's recent history.

papers.title: LaTune: Lightweight and Adaptive Configuration Tuning for LLM Inference on Edge Devices
papers.uses: Find which runtime settings matter most, reuse successful settings from past tuning runs, then quickly pick the best live configuration based on what system resources are available right now.

papers.title: Ethical Decision-Making under Moral Uncertainty
papers.uses: Balance competing moral frameworks by assigning weights to each ethical principle, learn which principles work best by trying arms, and dynamically adjust weights based on observed outcomes.

papers.title: Optimizing Multi-Turn Interactive Recommendation Agents via Generative Intrinsic Motivation
papers.uses: The system learns to act by assigning rewards based on three human drives (autonomy, competence, relatedness), then improves choices by descending toward better behavior.

papers.title: Bridging Expert Reasoning and LLM Detection: A Knowledge-Driven Framework for Malicious Packages
papers.uses: The detector retrieves similar dangerous code examples from a knowledge base, then uses reasoning to assess whether new code's purpose matches its behavior.

papers.title: AHBid: An Adaptable Hierarchical Bidding Framework for Cross-Channel Advertising
papers.uses: The system plans budget allocation across ad channels by sampling many plausible allocation paths from past patterns, then refining them in real-time as new outcomes arrive.

papers.title: SLFM: Semi-Supervised Local Community Detection Based on Hyperbolic Flow Matching
papers.uses: The system finds a community around a seed user by learning a lists of numbers field that smoothly transforms a generic distribution into the target community's shape in curved space, starting from a refined seed.

papers.title: CytoCrowd: A Multi-Annotator Benchmark Dataset for Cytology Image Analysis
papers.uses: Aggregate labels from multiple pathologists into a single quality judgment about each cell.

papers.title: Bandits, LLMs, and Agentic Web
papers.uses: An AI agent chooses actions by treating each option as an arm in a bandit; it learns which choices earn rewards, explores uncertain ones, and converges to the best strategies.

papers.title: G-SEIR: A Graph-Enhanced Epidemic Forecasting System for Dengue Intervention
papers.uses: Predict future dengue cases by running a learned disease-spread simulator on a spatio-temporal network, with parameters optimized to match past outbreak data.

papers.title: Multilingual Reference Need Assessment System for Wikipedia
papers.uses: Trains a model on ten languages simultaneously to spot Wikipedia claims that lack citations, balancing accuracy against the cost to run it at production scale.

papers.title: Benchmarking Temporal Web3 Intelligence: Lessons from the FinSurvival 2025 Challenge
papers.uses: Predict user transitions and survival in a blockchain platform using 16 survival prediction tasks on 21.8 million transactions, capturing temporal censoring and non-stationary patterns.

papers.title: FSDI: Frequency-Shaped Diffusion For Time-Series Imputation
papers.uses: Replaces uniform noise scheduling with frequency-specific noise amounts matched to how energy is actually distributed across the frequency spectrum of time series data.

papers.title: EdgeGen: Efficient LLM-Empowered Model Generation with Quantization-Aware NAS
papers.uses: Searches for neural architectures that perform well even after compression, by numeric fingerprints quantization into the search space and using tree-based random sampling to explore efficiently.

papers.title: AC$2$L-GAD: Active Counterfactual Contrastive Learning for Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.uses: Learns which pairs of network nodes are truly anomalies by comparing how similar they are and what's unusual about them.

papers.title: BANCO: Drift-Aware Batched Bandits for Adaptive Proximity Graph Pruning
papers.uses: Tries different strategies for removing graph edges and learns which works best as the data distribution changes over time.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Verbalized Probabilities for LLM Classification
papers.uses: Teach the language model to output word-based probability scores by rewarding it with feedback from expert math-based models trained on tabular data.
